Messages.Author: Ashur
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> Can anyone do a transcript of what has been said?
>
Quite alot was said about White Wolfs intentions with the new "One World of Darkness", new metaplots and the change of NWoD into "Chronicles of Darkness", so if you are interested in that, I recommend you to see the whole presentation.

About V:TES only one thing was said (unless I missed something!). It´s 19 min 20 sec in:
"People who are able to actually create things together with us, they get back to us and say 'What are you gonna do with this?', and I go: 'I don´t know, what do you guys wanna do?' So we´re in that process right now. And I can promise that as soon I we can tell the community anything about the products coming, we will. Just to comment on some of the questions we got, the card game, V:TES, for example, increasing interest. In Sweden we had a swedish championship in V:TES these days. Just amazing. Of course we have to do something with that one. We haven´t figured in out yet, but absolutely, we have to."

"My strategy? Luck is my strategy, of course."
